item.title: [News] Fudan University Spin-Off Nexilumen Advances Micro LED Optical Interconnect, Achieving 37 Gbps Bandwidth
item.description: Nexilumen, a spin-off from Fudan University, has made new progress in Micro LED optical interconnects, increasing aggregate bandwidth through space-division multiplexing (SDM) and wavelength-division multiplexing (WDM). Its 16-channel Micro LED array achieved a data rate of 37 Gbps, while a five-channel WDM solution reached a data-rate density of approximately 201 Gbps/mm². item.title: [News] Raontech and SN Display Collaborate on Perovskite-Based MicroLED Microdisplays
item.description: Korea's Raontech announced that it has signed an MoU with SN Display to co-develop perovskite-based next-generation AR/VR displays. The two companies are already conducting preliminary research in which SN Display's perovskite technology is applied to Raontech's microLED microdisplay samples, in order to verify the performance improvements and potential applications of next-generation microdisplays. item.title: 关键节点！维信诺合肥8.6代AMOLED产线转入设备调试阶段
item.description: 3月26日，合肥国显科技有限公司（以下简称合肥国显）第8.6代AMOLED生产线项目在主厂房举行洁净室清扫仪式，标志着全球首条搭载无FMM技术（ViP）的高世代AMOLED生产线已顺利完成厂房建设交付，全面转入工艺设备搬入及调试阶段，为产线后续顺利量产与运营奠定坚实基础。
